name: deploy
conclusion_quantitative: deploy (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 2 approval gates, 4 validation rules, 3 escalation rules; none for clarification rules. Strongest: validation rules.
conclusion_qualitative: deploy ships merged code to staging, production or another environment: pre-deployment checks, build, migrations, deployment and verification. Production migrations need explicit human approval, deployments are verified, and failures trigger rollback and escalation. It sets no clarification rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. Production migrations are applied during deployment after merge, never before.

statements.quote: Production migrations must be applied AFTER merge and DURING deployment, never before merge.

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 2 approval gates (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, all bullet points. A production migration plan needs explicit human approval at a mandatory checkpoint.

statements.quote: **Human approval**: Present migration plan for explicit approval
This is a mandatory human-in-the-loop checkpoint

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 4 validation rules (4 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 4 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, evenly split between running text and bullet points. The agent verifies readiness before deploying, dry-runs migrations, confirms the schema afterwards and confirms the deployment succeeded.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 3 escalation rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 1 tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. If a migration fails the agent rolls it back immediately, halts the deployment and escalates, and it follows a failure procedure when a deployment fails.
